title: A Multiscale Analysis of the CzrA Transcription Repressor Highlights the Allosteric Changes Induced by Metal Ion Binding.
authors: Rigoli, Marta; Potestio, Raffaello; Menichetti, Roberto
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和MEOW信息论方法分析CzrA转录抑制因子的别构调控机制，虽聚焦金属离子诱导的蛋白构象变化而非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但涉及TF-DNA结合调控的别构基础，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Allosteric regulation is a widespread strategy employed by several proteins to transduce chemical signals and perform biological functions. Metal sensor proteins are exemplary in this respect, e.g., in that they selectively bind and unbind DNA depending on the state of a distal ion coordination site. In this work, we carry out an investigation of the structural and mechanical properties of the CzrA transcription repressor through the analysis of microsecond-long molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories; the latter are processed through the mapping entropy optimization workflow (MEOW), a recently developed information-theoretical method that highlights, in an unsupervised manner, residues of particular mechanical, functional, and biological importance. The approach allows us to unveil how differences in the properties of the protein are controlled by the state of the zinc coordination site. These changes correlate with a redistribution of the conformational variability of the residues throughout the molecule, despite an overall consistency of its architecture in the two (ion-bound and free) coordination states. The results of this work corroborate previous studies, provide novel insight into the fine details of the mechanics of CzrA, and showcase the MEOW approach as a novel instrument for the study of allosteric regulation and other processes in proteins through the analysis of plain MD simulations.
abstract_zh: 变构调控是多种蛋白质用以转导化学信号并执行生物功能的普遍策略。金属传感器蛋白在这方面尤为典型，例如，它们根据远端离子配位位点的状态选择性结合和解离DNA。在本工作中，我们通过分析微秒级分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）轨迹，对CzrA转录抑制因子的结构和力学性质进行了研究；这些轨迹通过映射熵优化工作流（mapping entropy optimization workflow, MEOW）处理，这是一种近期发展的信息论方法，能够以无监督方式突出具有特殊力学、功能和生物学重要性的残基。该方法使我们得以揭示蛋白质性质的差异如何受锌配位位点状态的控制。这些变化与整个分子中残基构象变异性的重新分布相关，尽管在两种（离子结合和游离）配位状态下其整体架构保持一致。本工作的结果证实了先前的研究，为CzrA力学细节提供了新见解，并展示了MEOW方法作为通过分析普通MD模拟研究蛋白质变构调控及其他过程的新工具。
